module_findings.consequence: For one normally completed output, distinct certificates under the same unchanged rule can report failure and then success. The retained reducer specifies assignment without a contradiction guard, permitting the later success to determine qualification, whereas SettlePerformanceEvidence requires unresolved conflict. It also rejects a valid certificate received after complete content but before protocol FINAL. The supplied new metrics check handles these cases within its own reducer; that does not establish compatibility with the retained Goodput algorithm.

reviews.test_assessment: The retained resampling check compares ordered plans with an occupancy/multinomial reference and exercises proportional-pair invariants and actual denominator failures. Its t critical value is an input, and its finite distributions do not establish interval coverage. The new check verifies precision inversion against rational inequalities, strict binomial sample sizes against sequential exact search, and first-rejection probabilities through complete sequences, dynamic programming and intersection counts. The protocol executor exercises all-gate confirmation, failed final confirmation, incomplete prefixes and hard failure. Several named negative controls are explicit alternative-formula or branch-sensitivity comparisons, not full injected implementations. The evidence supports the stated finite arithmetic and stopping examples, including 13/256 and 215/16384, without validating arbitrary service inference.
